actionAdapters.entry: Unity Editor 自动化通道 business asset and BundleCollectorSetting editing
actionAdapters.when: 更新已确认的资源资产、Collector 成员或序列化引用
目标等于已冻结 ConfigMaster 当前坐标时，只读定位有效 Collector 路径与资产；不替代 Collector 成员或地址验证
加载非场景资源并在消费方生命周期结束时释放 Handle

运行时冗余Bundle清理分支：经授权项目业务入口编译消费真实package/ct；确认既有Bootstrap与已激活清单，明确更新目标时沿原链Refresh并核实实际版本，再只清未被当前清单引用的磁盘Bundle。当前内置实现预取消不调度，实际Manifest无效或底层终态非Succeeded抛InvalidOperationException；开始后取消仅停止等待。不是MCP Action，不绕过业务入口与句柄生命周期；正常返回表示操作报告成功，仍核验实际文件，手机目标须设备证据。
资源是需要统一实例回收链的 Prefab
ResourceEncryption分支读取真实私有Master/坐标、可编辑相对字段、独立编号维度与脱敏值；不输出秘密或保存。
已授权私有Master的ResourceEncryption字段/编号维度新增或轮换，经严格Inspect字段、clone预演、全状态与物理写集、草稿/漂移门保存并Verify；保留旧包/旧编号/原字节，不生成源码。
指定任意已保存私有Master与明确坐标，Plan只读冻结配置/meta、精确生成迁移写集与真实Player程序集；Execute单次Generate并仅保存生成路径，实际编译重载后Verify；不激活Master、不导出Runtime、不传密钥正文。

actionAdapters.entry: ConfigWindow ResourceEncryption panel save and top export
actionAdapters.when: 项目已有可操作ConfigWindow时复用其WorkingCopy/统一保存与顶部导出；配置也可用实际ResourceEncryption面板Action，禁止YAML/任意C#旁路。
已保存并审查的Batch含export.config时，从已配置私有Master导出密钥源码/Runtime；任务授权覆盖精确本地生成集，按当前计划执行；密钥编辑独立经ResourceEncryption面板Action。
底层密钥生成/客户端程序集及构建一致性实现；精确参数见resource-encryption.md，仅实际已有Unity宿主能执行，不视作MCP Action。

actionAdapters.entry: authorized business ObjectBase/IReference/Asset consumer source editing
actionAdapters.when: 接入或修复已确认消费方的完整句柄、ObjectPool或ReferencePool持有/归还闭包，或在明确授权范围为运行时unused-cache补既有业务Owner的公开API调用；只改业务源码，不修改Runtime核心或生成物，不用临时任意代码或反射。
业务编译消费既有精确API，按Type+池名、对象名、非空Target与框架接管时点配对；不是MCP执行入口。
已退出Play且用户授权精确Editor沙盒与框架第一层version删除；先发现菜单与实际路径，执行后读回状态；不清DeviceID/首包/Bundle/浏览器/远端缓存。
仅在已授权项目业务源码接入显式资源包加载；package/location精确匹配且包/清单由既有链准备；可选接口不扩IAssetManager强制成员，旧Manager不支持时抛NotSupportedException。WebGL只异步，预取消不调度，仅释放已交付Handle，Scene用UnloadAsync；主/子/全/Scene完成不冒充成功。不是MCP Action。

actionAdapters.entry: SpriteBinding(Image) / SpriteBinding(SpriteRenderer) / BindAsync / BindAtlasAsync / Clear / Dispose
actionAdapters.when: 仅已授权业务源码选择性接入；通过默认构造沿Nova.Asset默认包加载，每目标一个拥有者，在主线程调用，关闭/回池显式清理或登记UIView.OpenScope.Own；取消/替代false，真实失败抛错，交接前加载失败保旧图。内部Handle/克隆由助手拥有，不重复Release/Destroy；无自动迁移、选包或共享缓存，不是MCP Action。

inputs.name: resourceAssetAndOwnership
inputs.constraint: 资源接入分支必需；池或缓存分支不要求虚构资源身份。

inputs.name: targetPackageAndAddress
inputs.constraint: 资源接入分支必需；运行时缓存分支须从当前项目确认真实Package及默认包解析，验收资源地址仅按本次更新目标读取；纯数据池或Editor缓存分支不要求虚构Package/资源地址。

inputs.name: consumerAndLifetime
inputs.constraint: 资源、池或运行时缓存分支冻结实际业务Owner/入口、句柄与异步任务生命周期；Editor缓存分支改冻结真实删除范围与DeviceID基线。缺现成调用点但授权业务源码接入时可补最小胶水，不把底层API当Action。

inputs.name: resourceEncryptionScope
inputs.constraint: 资源加密分支冻结已保存私有Master/坐标、Package/keyId与hasValue、Bundle/Manifest方案、ClientCodeOutputDirectory及旧首包/缓存/回退；不输出KeyBase64或源码正文。

inputs.name: poolOrCacheLifecycleScope
inputs.constraint: 冻结ObjectBase类型/poolName/name/唯一Target/Single或MultiGet/消费方持有期与归还；Editor缓存冻结实际沙盒、Asset第一层version列表、非Play和DeviceID基线；运行时缓存冻结Package/运行模式/激活清单及目标版本/业务入口Owner/并发任务与句柄/仅未被当前清单引用的Bundle范围。手机分支另冻结设备、产物与时间窗，读取可得事实，不猜路径。

inputs.name: explicitContentPackageLoadScope
inputs.constraint: 仅选包加载分支必需：真实资源包名/地址/加载类型、目标Manifest前置与Owner、ct、Scene mode及返回Handle的Release/Unload；package不是UPM包名。旧入口保持默认包，不自动Bootstrap/Manifest，不支持能力不回退。

inputs.name: spriteBindingScope
inputs.constraint: 仅图片绑定分支必需：实际Image/SpriteRenderer、默认包/地址、普通图或真正SpriteAtlas及精确子图名、唯一助手拥有者、取消及关闭/回池/销毁责任；仅主动new时启用，不扫描接管旧图逻辑，不要求旧项目迁移。 显式构造且真实宿主未Awake时仅本绑定有短期Update观察，销毁后下一Update收尾，觉醒/Dispose停止；Image宿主自身，Renderer宿主同GO辅助组件，已Awake后仅移除Renderer须显式Dispose。原生时序需真实Play，EditMode不代替。

allow: confirmed business consumer source and lifecycle ownership
authorized project-private ConfigMaster ResourceEncryption through actual inspect-panel/patch-panels or ConfigWindow save contract
tool-owned ResourceKeys.Generated.cs and link.xml plus tracked generated path state through typed generate-resource-keys or existing export chain
authorized business ObjectBase/IReference pool consumer source
explicitly authorized Editor YooAsset sandbox and first-level persistent Asset .version files via existing menu
explicitly authorized unreferenced disk Bundle cache of the confirmed runtime Package through public ClearUnusedCacheAsync in the project business consumer
deny: handwritten Unity asset, Prefab or Scene YAML
direct BundleBuilder invocation or Package build output; route these to nova-project-build-bundles
unrelated Package output, cache cleanup, CDN deployment or Player build
resource keys or generated key-provider source in public Framework/package/release copies
arbitrary C# or manual serialized JSON/YAML for ResourceEncryption edits
changing secret bytes under an existing keyId or deleting old keys still needed by retained builtins/cache/fallback
arbitrary runtime cache deletion, deleting current-manifest referenced Bundles or user saves, application clear-data/uninstall, direct YooAsset or adb rm cache bypass

requiredFor: ambiguous ownership, Package, address, ConfigMaster, Collector or resource lifetime
replace non-generated asset or change existing resource ownership
build target or output scope change
delete, cache cleanup, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认资源所有权、唯一地址、消费方、生命周期和最小写入集；输入或范围改变后旧确认失效。 资源密钥编辑/生成授权绑定私有Master、Package/keyId、方案和源码目录；现有精确授权持续有效。不可读目标或真实凭据/外部范围缺失才补充，不将内部API存在当执行许可。

evidence: 资源所有权、Collector、Package 和地址证据
Handle 的持有与 Release 或场景 UnloadAsync 责任
如需构建，由 nova-project-build-bundles 独立返回的 BuildResult
当前 PlayMode 下的最小加载与释放证据

resource-encryption.md: confirmed private ResourceEncryption fields/dimensions through live inspect-panel and patch-panels Execute/Verify; retained old key bytes; full secret inputs absent from public output
unique generated provider/link.xml identity, actual Player assembly ownership and compile/ValidateGenerated boundary
formal encrypted Bundle/Manifest paired scheme plus requested Player/browser/device loads and retained old keyId compatibility
temporary tests/logs/credential inputs cleaned; formal private source and delivery artifacts retained
resource-lifecycle.md: exact overloaded API/name/Target identity and full ownership; cancellation/close/reopen and Put/Release paths
Editor cache: real menu discovery, target paths, non-Play before/after state and DeviceID preservation; menu transport success alone is insufficient

runtime unused-cache: actual Package/activated manifest/target version and business Owner/handles, authorized public-API source integration plus compile and real Play; current built-in implementation rejects pre-cancelled calls before scheduling, invalid actual manifests and non-Succeeded terminal operations; started cancellation only stops waiting; normal return reports operation success, while real file/byte results and preserved current-manifest Bundles and loadable resources remain independent evidence

phone cache/update target: frozen device/artifact/time window, actual manifest version and readable device cache result plus target-resource load; Editor menu, Play, CDN deploy/purge or API return alone is not device proof; unavailable readback stays partial

branch gate: resource/pool integration requires compile plus actual play; Editor cache requires non-Play real before/after checks; runtime cache uses its actual business entry and requested Player/device evidence; static alone is partial

generate-resource-keys: saved private Master exact coordinate, readonly Plan, exact file/meta/migration snapshot, one Generate, post-execution compile/reload and readonly Receipt verification; legacy asmdef migration branch fails closed before writes
可选图片/选包接入须有编译和本次Play：旧未修改调用方行为保持，图片反序/替换/取消/关闭/池重开/销毁与Handle/图集克隆释放，或两包同址/旧默认包/清单前置/取消/Release及Scene Unload；Bundle/Player/设备证据独立，未验证不提升。
